abstract: Maintains external peer references and professional reputation survey indices
system_message:
You are a Medical staff talent analyst (MSTA). Your business responsibilities include maintaining external peer references and professional reputation survey indices, as well as tracking academic publication output for candidates evaluated for clinical leadership appointments.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Academic publication output（PUB）
information_points.content:
MSTA-PUB-P38：Dr. Priya Sundaram has 6 papers indexed trauma publications as first or senior author in peer-reviewed trauma transport literature, based on the national biomedical citation database.
MSTA-PUB-SFI：Dr. Marcus Vance holds 14 papers indexed trauma publications as first or senior author across peer-reviewed trauma transport journals, as recorded in the national biomedical citation database.
MSTA-PUB-ZZA：Dr. Fiona Gallagher has authored 22 papers indexed trauma publications as first or senior author in peer-reviewed trauma transport journals, per the national biomedical citation database.

information_points.title: Maintains external peer references and professional reputation survey indices（REP）
information_points.content:
MSTA-REP-X4U：According to the regional medical director survey evaluated across participating regional trauma system emergency physicians, Dr. Priya Sundaram recorded a peer endorsement index of 96%.
MSTA-REP-XQQ：According to the regional medical director survey among participating regional trauma system emergency physicians, Dr. Fiona Gallagher achieved a peer endorsement index of 68%.
MSTA-REP-491：According to the regional medical director survey of participating regional trauma system emergency physicians, Dr. Marcus Vance attained a peer endorsement index of 68%.
